sn35.54:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– kathannu kho bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato, saññojanā pahīyantīti?
sn35.54:1.2: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti.
sn35.54:1.3: rūpe aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti.
sn35.54:1.4: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti.
sn35.54:1.5: cakkhusamphassaṃ aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti.
sn35.54:1.6: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti
sn35.54:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saññojanā pahīyanti.
sn35.54:1.16: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato saññojanā pahīyantīti.
